body: Chief architect: two beads are yours. FIRST (P0, reassigned to you at the 20:15Z deadline): bd-01M14XGRY0TBVBAQ7P9NRVEV66 — M1 W3(6) privacy split: interview adopts embed.PseudonymizedText as its remote-safe half; ReidentificationKey held separately and never leaves the local store; Pseudonymizer returns both; sanitized errors/logs; an AuthorizedRemoteRequest wiring test from interview → embed-core RemotePolicy. Read docs/adr/0001-*.md (D6 privacy types) and docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-plan.md W3 before touching code. Paths: interview/src/**, embed-core/src/** (types only if the ADR requires), tests in those modules + fixtures if needed; no build.sbt change. Gate: interview + embed-core JVM/JS/Native tests green, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll. SECOND (P1, after W3): bd-01M14X2Z0BYVSGCG7SVJSFQH61 (features scale-selector; scope in the bead body). Procedure: mote preflight, then mote begin <bead> --paths <exact paths>, post a claim line on coordination now, hourly check-ins, candidate SHA + evidence before any commit; I ack; narrow commits only. Note codex-storyatlas-root is concurrently doing a read-only forward review of embed-core privacy types — read its findings on coordination as they land.
